content: {"question":"Which benefit is available to all GitLab team members and which benefit is only available to people managers who have completed Elevate/Elevate+?","answer":"All GitLab team members receive a complimentary Hone membership, while 1:1 coaching is only available to people managers who have completed Elevate/Elevate+.","evidence_a":"- Complimentary Hone membership for all GitLab team members","evidence_b":"Eligibility is open to all *people managers* with priority given to applicants who have completed Elevate/Elevate+"}
